CITY OF ALHAMBRA DESIGN REVIEW BOARD
  ACTION MINUTES

  Regular Meeting
  May 27, 2025

  The audio recording of the meeting is available here: DRB Meeting – May 27, 2025 (Audio)

A.  CALL MEETING TO ORDER:  7:00 P.M. in Community Development Conference Room,
  1st Floor of Alhambra City Hall.

B.  ROLL CALL:

  Present:  Nora Hernandez, Chairman; Ankit Udani, Vice Chairman; Michael
  Daninger; Stanley Tsai; Jennifer Ng

  Staff Present: Steve Kuchenski, Secretary/City Architect; Eric Martinez, City Architect
  Representative

C.  CONSENT AGENDA:

  AGENDA
  ITEM 1:  MINUTES – May 13, 2025
  • Request: This is a request for the Design Review Board to approve
  the Minutes of the May 13, 2025, Regular Meeting of the Design
  Review Board.
  • Recommended Action: Design Review Board review and approve
  as submitted the Minutes of the May 13, 2025, Regular Meeting of
  the Design Review Board.

  MOTION:
  •  Moved to approve Consent Agenda Item 1.
  •  Moved by Board Member Daninger, Seconded by Board Member Ng.
  •  The motion carried by the following roll call vote:

  Roll Call Vote: 5-0-0-0
  Ayes:  Hernandez, Udani, Daninger, Tsai, Ng
  Noes:  None
  Abstain: None
  Absent:  None

D.  DISCUSSION ITEMS:

  AGENDA
  ITEM 2:  DESIGN REVIEW BOARD DRB-25-038
  • 101 South Atlantic Boulevard
  • Applicant: Nicholas Lopez
  • Request: This is an application to reface both sides of an existing
  monument sign on an existing church property.
  1
  05/27/2025
   •  Recommended Action: APPROVE - The proposed project is
  approved without conditions.

MOTION:
  •  Moved to approve the application without conditions.
  •  Moved by Board Member Daninger, Seconded by Board Member
  Tsai.
  •  The motion carried by the following roll call vote:

  Roll Call Vote: 5-0-0-0
  Ayes:  Hernandez, Udani, Daninger, Tsai, Ng
  Noes:  None
  Abstain: None
  Absent:  None

AGENDA
ITEM 3:  DESIGN REVIEW BOARD DRB-24-155
  • 25 North Garfield Avenue
  • Applicant: Nicky Chung
  • Request: This is an application for a new channel letter wall sign on
  an existing 1-story commercial building.
  • Recommended Action: APPROVE. The proposed project is
  approved without conditions.

MOTION:
  •  Moved to approve the application without conditions.
  •  Moved by Board Member Daninger, Seconded by Board Member
  Tsai.
  •  The motion carried by the following roll call vote:

  Roll Call Vote: 5-0-0-0
  Ayes:  Hernandez, Udani, Daninger, Tsai, Ng
  Noes:  None
  Abstain: None
  Absent:  None

AGENDA
ITEM 4:  DESIGN REVIEW BOARD DRB-25-027
  • 600 East Valley Boulevard
  • Applicant: Will Mojica
  • Request: This is an application for exterior improvements to an
  existing 1-story commercial building for a new commercial tenant
  Ross, including a wall cover and fascia on an existing sign canopy,
  new exterior paint finish, new threaded eye-bolt to hang future
  temporary signage, and a new fencing and gate enclosure around the
  existing loading area.

  2
  05/27/2025
   •  Recommended Action: APPROVE WITH CONDITIONS. The
  proposed project is approved with the following Conditions of
  Approval:

  1) For the Design Review Board to review and recommend a paint
  color for the canopy, and the fence and gate enclosure at the east
  loading dock area.

MOTION:
  •  Moved to approve the application with the following Conditions of
  Approval:

  1) Update the drawings to show the new fence and gate paint color
  to match the primary building color.
  2) Provide a note on the plans stating that any new accent paint
  colors to be consistent throughout the project.

  •  Moved by Board Member Hernandez, Seconded by Board Member
  Tsai.
  •  The motion carried by the following roll call vote:

  Roll Call Vote: 5-0-0-0
  Ayes:  Hernandez, Udani, Daninger, Tsai, Ng
  Noes:  None
  Abstain: None
  Absent:  None

AGENDA
ITEM 5:  DESIGN REVIEW BOARD DRB-24-129
  • 1325 South Palm Avenue
  • Applicant: Clarence Vong
  • Request: This is an application for a new 729 SF 1-story addition to
  an existing 1-story single-family residential house, including a 200 SF
  addition to the front of the house and a 529 SF addition to the rear of
  the house.
  • Recommended Action: APPROVE WITH CONDITIONS. The
  proposed project is approved with the following Conditions of
  Approval:

  1) The applicant to clarify if a wall cap is proposed for the front porch
  low wall.

MOTION:
  •  Moved to approve the application with the following Conditions of
  Approval:

  1) Shift the front window to be positioned between the proposed
  porch post and increase window scale.
  2) The applicant should remove the front porch CMU wall.
  3) Extend the front porch post to the ground.
  3
  05/27/2025
   4) Provide a note on the plans stating that all existing and new fascia
  paint color to be consistent throughout.

  •  Moved by Board Member Ng, Seconded by Board Member Daninger.
  •  The motion carried by the following roll call vote:

  Roll Call Vote: 5-0-0-0
  Ayes:  Hernandez, Udani, Daninger, Tsai, Ng
  Noes:  None
  Abstain: None
  Absent:  None

AGENDA
ITEM 6:  DESIGN REVIEW BOARD DRB-25-055
  • 2504 Whitney Drive
  • Applicant: Annie Tan
  • Request: This is an application for a new 49 SF 1-story addition to
  the front and enclose an existing 204 SF covered patio on an existing
  single-family residence.
  • Recommended Action: APPROVE. The proposed project is
  approved without conditions.

MOTION:
  •  Moved to approve the application with the following Conditions of
  Approval:

  1) Shift front living room window to be centered between front porch
  posts.
  2) The applicant shall resubmit a revised set of drawings for City
  Architect to verify and approve.

  •  Moved by Board Member Tsai, Seconded by Board Member Udani.
  •  The motion carried by the following roll call vote:

  Roll Call Vote: 5-0-0-0
  Ayes:  Hernandez, Udani, Daninger, Tsai, Ng
  Noes:  None
  Abstain: None
  Absent:  None

AGENDA
ITEM 7:  DESIGN REVIEW BOARD DRB-25-030
  • 1101 South Ethel Avenue
  • Applicant: Salvador Pineda
  • Request: This is an application for a new exterior remodel and a new
  6-foot-high fence and gate on the interior and street side yards of an
  existing single-family residence.
  • Recommended Action: APPROVE. The proposed project is
  approved without conditions.

  4
  05/27/2025
   MOTION:
  •  Moved to approve the application with the following Conditions of
  Approval:

  1) Indicate on the site plan that planting is proposed along the
  outside of the proposed fencing.

  •  Moved by Board Member Udani, Seconded by Board Member
  Daninger.
  •  The motion carried by the following roll call vote:

  Roll Call Vote: 5-0-0-0
  Ayes:  Hernandez, Udani, Daninger, Tsai, Ng
  Noes:  None
  Abstain: None
  Absent:  None

E.  ORAL COMMUNICATIONS:

  •  There were no Oral Communications.

F.  ADJOURNMENT:

  •  There being no other business, the meeting was adjourned at 8:20 P.M. to
  Tuesday, June 10, 2025, at 7:00 P.M.

  _____________________________
  Nora Hernandez
  Chairman
